title: No silent work: every job shows in the queue (umbrella)
description: Fabio 2026-10-12: every job the user (or Cosmo / an outside agent) starts must show itself. GPU work goes in the generation queue + status bar; non-GPU work (downloads, uploads, CPU / ffmpeg / file copies) goes in the queue panel's existing Transfers rows with a progress bar; a job with no real progress number shows the existing moving left-to-right sweep, never nothing. Nothing new gets built: reuse the Transfers row, MpiProgressBar and its sweep. Rule: .claude/rules/dos_and_donts.md section 'Every action shows itself' (MPI-1100). Members and phase order: this card's plan.md. MPI-896 (Feedback surface) merged in 2026-10-18 (Fabio, board tidy): MPI-569, MPI-543, MPI-302 joined.
